caption:
They told me the data was encrypted, but they didn't tell me the view would be this breathtaking. 🍂✨

I stood on the edge of the 90th floor, the orange neon of the 'Cyber-Autumn' festival painting the mist in shades of copper and fire. My bodysuit hugged every curve, the tech-fabric warm against my skin as the chilly rain began to fall. 🌃 I wasn't just here for the 'Frostbite' drive; I was here for the thrill of the chase. My contact moved into my personal space, the scent of ozone and spiced cider clinging to his coat. His gaze drifted down, lingering on the swell of my chest before locking onto my eyes with a dangerous intensity. A jolt of electricity—real or programmed—shot through me as he reached out, his fingers grazing my wrist. The data transfer was seamless, but the heat between us was anything but. In the heart of the neon jungle, some secrets are best kept in the shadows. 🔥
